# Arjun P

> Arjun P is an AI engineer at Qilin Labs in India. He builds AI agents, the developer tools they run on, and AI products. He is open to AI engineering roles and selected client projects.

## Projects

- [bare](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/bare.html): A web browser written from scratch in Rust, with hand-written TLS, HTTP/2, HTML, CSS, layout and JavaScript, and an MCP server that agents use to test sites.
- [deck](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/deck.html): An open-source, self-hosted alternative to Grok Bot. The owner chats with several AI bots, such as an email bot or a job-hunting bot, and each bot works in its own virtual computer.
- [hyprcage](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/hyprcage.html): A virtual screen for AI agents on Hyprland. Agents read the screen as text before they take a screenshot.
- [reviewer](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/reviewer.html): A local AI code reviewer in Rust, measured against CodeRabbit on 52 pull requests built from real bug fixes.
- [figma-connect](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/figma-connect.html): A local Figma MCP server that renders generated code and compares it with the design.
- [git-guard](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/git-guard.html): Git hooks that hold coding agents and people to the same commit rules.
- [share](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/share.html): A small service that publishes one HTML page at a link that expires.
- [EdTech Assessment Platform](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/edtech-platform.html): Web and mobile assessments for schools, graded with Claude vision.
- [AI Product Configurator](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/product-configurator.html): A product configurator with an AI assistant inside a live Shopify theme.
- [Suzuki Connect RE](https://www.arjunp.pro/projects/suzuki-connect-re.html): Reverse engineering of a motorcycle Bluetooth protocol and an Android navigation app.

## Writing

- [All writing](https://www.arjunp.pro/writing/): Articles on coding agents, AI products and web engineering.
- [Lab notebook](https://mrwick.dev): Notes on a homelab and agent tooling.
